supply-vale.scene: Scornfang's defended reclamation office, supplies ledgers and private Goblin household; ordinary work under imposed security, not Thornfang's estate.

supply-march.scene: Mirejaw's guarded three-cache treasury and wetland logistics; an occupied raid context, not invented family tragedy.

supply-highlands.scene: Ridge Tyrant's guarded residence: wealth and ledgers alongside supper, games and comfortable Ogre domestic life under coercive administration.

side-vale-cellars.scene: Old Orchard Cellars shelter displaced Goblin workers, families and children; preserves are bought, beds and games are present, danger coexists with refuge.

side-march-watchhouse.scene: Drowned Watchhouse: formerly a military post, now an inhabited Reed Beast dwelling with nests, fish racks and shells among the floodwater.

side-highlands-signal.scene: Old Signal Keep remains an active Crown-service signal station with Ogre households, tools, supper, watch duties and leisure.

side-frontier-shrine.scene: Ruined Shrine: an occupied Orc barracks and workspace maintaining ritual furnishings, organized drills and everyday life among older masonry.
